title: Activities shortcut location is in plasmashell, which is confusing
line: The Switch to Next/Previous Activity shortcuts now sit under Activity Manager, next to the shortcuts for each activity.
explanation: plasmashell registered the Switch to Next/Previous Activity global shortcuts on its own component, so System Settings listed them under Plasma Workspace, while kactivitymanagerd registered the per-activity shortcuts under Activity Manager. Users looking for activity shortcuts found only half of them in Activity Manager. kactivitymanagerd now registers the next/previous actions (same action names, calling its own NextActivity/PreviousActivity), plasmashell no longer registers them, and a plasma-workspace kconf_update script moves any custom key from plasmashell to ActivityManager.

commits.message:
globalshortcuts: add next and previous activity shortcuts

The shortcuts to cycle through activities lived in plasmashell, so they
showed up under Plasma Workspace while the ones for each activity were
under Activity Manager. Register them here, next to the others, instead.

BUG: 484583

shell: move the next/previous activity shortcuts to Activity Manager

Switch to Next/Previous Activity were registered by plasmashell, away
from the per-activity shortcuts that kactivitymanagerd owns. Drop them
here and move any custom shortcut over with a kconf_update script.

BUG: 484583

media.caption: Before: searching "activit" in Shortcuts, Activity Manager only has the per-activity shortcuts
After: Activity Manager also has Switch to Next/Previous Activity, with the user's custom keys carried over
Before: Switch to Next/Previous Activity are listed under Plasma Workspace
After: Plasma Workspace keeps only the activity switcher shortcuts (Meta+Q, Meta+A, Meta+Shift+A)
